learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how to use your eyes, smiles, and frowns to share big feelings while dancing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Your face is the brightest part of your dance! A big smile shows joy, while wide eyes can show surprise or fear.
In traditional Indian dance, the beautiful art of showing emotions through facial expressions is called Abhinaya.
When you feel the music in your heart, your body naturally moves to show sadness, anger, or extreme happiness.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Emotion Mirror Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Stand in front of a mirror and practice making three different faces: super angry, very sleepy, and jumping with joy. Notice how your eyebrows change!

quick_recap: ⭐ Facial expressions help the audience understand exactly what the dancer is feeling.
⭐ Abhinaya is the beautiful Indian art of expressive acting in dance.
⭐ Our eyes and eyebrows are very important for showing strong emotions.
